summary: Build facility baselines, controls and KPI reports for hotel sustainability. Review the five-day course and plan your next step.
lede: Sustainable hospitality facilities management brings environmental performance into view alongside guest comfort, maintenance and service continuity. For accommodation facilities managers, engineering managers and sustainability coordinators, the course develops practical skills to define facility boundaries, validate utility data, build energy and water indicators, assign environmental controls, and prepare priorities and management reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who manage, measure or report environmental performance in accommodation facilities. It suits professionals who can contribute facility data and operational examples, even when their current records sit across several teams.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with hospitality facility operations or environmental performance records is recommended. No programming is required.
